name: realm-play
description: Desktop-only, source-only read-only REALM MCP pilot for one host-bound player.

interface.longDescription: Source-only desktop preview for a host-bound REALM player. Its local launcher pins the strict engine MCP tool allowlist to realm_status and realm_look, rejecting inherited broad scopes; older engines without enforcement are refused. Requires a compatible strict REALM engine source, an existing world, host-owned player token and working local Python MCP host. No join, movement, speech, inventory, map, feed, arbitrary game command, ChatGPT Web connectivity or remote service is provided.
interface.defaultPrompt: If local REALM MCP tools are actually available and host-qualified, call realm_status and realm_look only to observe the bound player and world. Do not join, mutate, access history or map, or assume the plugin package grants host permission.
